L9·N9925unmasked layer
This neuron fires on the final/head token that completes a multi-token compound noun or proper-name phrase (e.g. "WordPress **theme**", "SEF **Canada**", "Jamaican Pato**is**", "trekking **company**") right before the phrase becomes the subject of a description; it is strongly suppressed on the analogous position in quote-attribution contexts (a speaker name plus "said"/"explained").
